IF(CONTAINS(TEXT(Contract__c), "はなまる"),
MID( IF(ISBLANK(ContractCompany__c), "、取引先", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Contract_date__c), "、契約日", "") & IF(ISBLANK(ModelYearPickList__c), "、年式", "") & IF(ISBLANK(CarNo__c), "、車台番号", "") & IF(ISBLANK(run_dist__c), "、走行距離", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Navigation__c)), "、ナビ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(AW__c)), "、AW", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Equipment__c), "、装備品", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(meter__c)), "、メーター", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Tax_payment__c)), "、納税", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Repair_history__c)), "、修復歴", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Defect__c)), "、不具合", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Liability__c)), "、自賠責", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Crown_water__c)), "、冠水歴", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Purchase_condition__c)), "、買取条件", "") & IF(ISBLANK(AssessmentDate__c), "、査定日", "") & IF(ISBLANK(TotalPayment__c), "、支払合計", "") , 2, 999)
, "" )
